responsibility: Implements the `ldtoa` long-double conversion helpers for GNU Modula-2, parsing strings into `long double` values and formatting long doubles into dynamically allocated textual representations. It mirrors the `dtoa` logic but targets extended precision and uses host `strtold` when available, falling back to `strtod` otherwise, while also reusing the shared decimal-point and sign adjustment helpers.
same_name_distinction: Implements long-double text conversion, using strtold when available and reusing helper routines from dtoa for sign and decimal-point adjustment, whereas gcc/m2/pge-boot/Gldtoa.h only declares the long-double conversion modes and entry points.
